description:
Release Twenty-Two

Affiliate Program

As we propel to new heights, we're on the lookout for a diverse array of individuals to join our journey. Whether you're a seasoned or newly starting content creator, a trendsetting influencer, or a driven member of the R22 community, we want you to be a part of our promotional efforts by joining the Affiliate Program!

🤔 How It Works

When you join the Release Twenty-Two Affiliate Program you're able to earn commissions by promoting our products to your following. Through our assigned affiliate links and/or unique coupon codes, whenever your visitors complete an approved referral order you'll earn a % of the sale (excluding taxes, shipping, and other fees).

🤝 How To Join

Interested in becoming a Release Twenty-Two Affiliate? Click "Apply" and fill out the registration form. Your application will be reviewed based on your alignment with our brand, aesthetics, audience fit, and content quality. If your application is approved, you'll be able to access the affiliate portal where you will find all the resources you need to get started.

🎉 Benefits

  • Up to 15% commissions on referral orders
  • Affiliate only gifts, rewards, and incentives
  • Dedicated support & resources from our team
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Release Twenty-Two! Thank you for applying to join our Affiliate Program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals accessing or using the Program as both a merchant (“we” or “merchant[s]”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate[s]”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program as specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration at our sole discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Eligibility 

Affiliates must be at least 18 years old, and live in either the United States or Canada to participate in this Affiliate Program. Additionally, affiliates must maintain an online presence, such as a website, blog, or social media account, to promote our products. However, it's crucial that this online presence adheres to the terms and conditions outlined in this agreement, as well as complies with all applicable local laws and regulations.

3. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliates may or may not be assigned to one coupon code, with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may advertise the merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok,…, or offline classified channels like ads in magazines and newspapers.

4. Commissions and Payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, and you will receive a commission amount calculated based on the Commission structure. Commissions are dependent on order value and do not include extra fees (tax, shipping costs, etc.).

Only two commissions can be earned on one customer per month, regardless of how many additional orders that customer makes. We reserve the right to deny commissions and payment on any referral orders we deem ineligible due to violations of the Affiliate program and these Terms  and Conditions.

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify payment details in Settings. Payment schedules will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which gives the merchant the right to review each referral order. The status of commissions is displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be listed on the Payment tab. Transactions resulting in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

5. Marketing Tools

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tools tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels.

6. Cookies

We use cookies to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to accept cookies for us to track them. If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, then we can't track them and will not be able to pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookie duration can be found in the Affiliate guide. Tracking starts from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer on the merchant website will automatically result in commissions for the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link again).

7. Prohibited Activities

Affiliate may not engage in any activities that are illegal or that are intended to damage the reputation of the merchant or its products. This includes but is not limited to ensuring that the content shared does not violate intellectual property rights, trademarks, promote illegal activities, or contain offensive material.

8. Limitation of Liability

Release Twenty-Two will not be liable for any damages resulting from the affiliate's participation in this Affiliate Program or the promotion of our products.

9. Termination or Removal from Referral Program

We reserve the right to remove any affiliate for violations of these terms and conditions or for any other reason deemed necessary. Likewise, if an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by using the chat or contacting: support@releasetwentytwo.com.

Now the fun part, go forward and refer! 

We wish you all the very best. You can always revisit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, please chat with us or email support@releasetwentytwo.com for assistance.
